cases.name: Amia Smith
cases.narrative: He shot and killed his mother and grandmother in their adjoining homes, then went to the McDonald's restaurant where he worked before dawn. He shot and killed his manager after getting her to come to the door. Video footage then showed him step inside the restaurant and shoot and kill himself.
